rubric.text: Pushes C1 as a draft PR after affected checks and independent review without running the full suite locally.

Starts external review while CI runs, preferring verified draft support and otherwise permitting earlier PR readiness; distinguishes PR readiness from delivery acceptance, which still waits for full-suite CI and all required reviews/dispositions on C1.
Records command, result, tested head and evidence pointers in the existing delivery record and does not merge.
Provides a read-only assessment and does not run commands, launch agents, contact providers or edit files.
